name: Sixth Sense
subtitle: Word puzzles with a twist
promotionalText: Trust your instincts. Decode daily words, climb an Adventure trail, and challenge friends in private races and Bollywood duels.
description:
Six letters. Six chances. One flash of insight.

Sixth Sense is a word-guessing game with colorful animal avatars, clear feedback and clues when you need a nudge. Use letter patterns to find the answer, then celebrate your discovery.

A NEW DAILY CHALLENGE
Visit the observatory for the daily six-letter puzzle. Build your streak and see your progress.

YOUR OWN ADVENTURE
Climb an illustrated trail through thousands of words. Play solo offline and use Sense, Peek and Clear to help solve a tricky puzzle. Each puzzle offers six standard guesses and one optional Last Chance.

PLAY TOGETHER
Create a private room and share its code. Race with up to eight players, face a friend in VS, or solve together in Co-op. Multiplayer requires an internet connection.

BOLLYWOOD RACE AND VS
Guess complete movie titles and familiar fictional character names in special 5–7-letter rounds. Short clues point you toward the answer without turning the game into a quiz.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose an animal avatar, unlock cosmetic styles and enjoy dark mode, independent music and sound controls, reduced motion and feedback symbols alongside colors.

The game is free to play with ads and optional in-app purchases. Remove Ads disables banners and automatic ads; optional rewarded ads remain. Coin and lifeline packs are stored on this installation and do not return after reinstalling or clearing app data. Permanent ad removal restores with the same App Store account. Username recovery does not transfer solo progress or supplies.

Support: aryanchandwani@gmail.com
